template.prompt: Describe the task for the agent.

prompt.summary: Inline AI node: the agent runs the prompt text.

fields.name: prompt
fields.help: The agent's instructions. Variables and $node.output references are substituted before the agent starts.

prompt.trap: Use idle_timeout, not timeout: timeout on a prompt node is an error.

command.summary: AI node whose prompt is the file .archon/commands/<name>.md.

fields.name: command
fields.help: The command file name, with no path separators, no '..' and no leading dot.

fields.name: with
fields.help: Named inputs for the command, each a literal or a { from: '$node.output', if_skipped } binding.

command.trap: Use idle_timeout, not timeout: timeout on a command node is an error.

bash.summary: Runs a shell script. No AI. The output is stdout minus one trailing newline.

fields.name: bash
fields.help: The shell script. Only $WORKFLOW_ID, $ARTIFACTS_DIR, $STATE_DIR, $BASE_BRANCH, $DOCS_DIR and node references are substituted as text; other variables arrive as environment variables, including INPUTS_<NAME>.

fields.name: timeout
fields.help: Milliseconds before the script is stopped.

fields.name: on_timeout
fields.help: With 'skip', a timeout skips the node instead of failing it.

bash.trap: with: on a bash node is an error. A node reference is single-quote escaped when it is substituted.

script.summary: Runs a script under bun or uv. No AI.

fields.name: script
fields.help: The script source.

fields.name: runtime
fields.help: The interpreter.

fields.name: deps
fields.help: Packages the runtime installs first.

fields.name: timeout
fields.help: Milliseconds before the script is stopped.

fields.name: on_timeout
fields.help: With 'skip', a timeout skips the node.

fields.name: with
fields.help: Named inputs, each a JSON value or a { from } binding.

script.trap: bun is not installed on this machine, so a bun script cannot run here.

loop.summary: One AI node repeated until a check passes.

fields.name: loop
fields.help: { prompt or command, max_iterations, and one of until, until_bash, until_field; optional fresh_context }.

fields.name: timeout
fields.help: Milliseconds that bound each until_bash run.

loop.trap: until_field names a boolean that must be declared and required in the node's output_format.

loop_group.summary: A sub-graph repeated until until_bash passes or max_iterations is reached.

fields.name: loop_group
fields.help: { nodes, max_iterations, until_bash (or until), optional fresh_context }.

fields.name: timeout
fields.help: Milliseconds that bound each until_bash run.

loop_group.trap: A pause in the body must be the body's last node, so the loop sees your answer only in the next round. max_iterations includes the settling round. until_field is an error here.

approval.summary: Deprecated pause; a wait node replaces it.

fields.name: approval
fields.help: { message, decisions or on_reject, capture_response }.

approval.trap: decisions and on_reject are mutually exclusive.

wait.summary: A pause: stops the run until a person answers or a time passes.

fields.name: wait
fields.help: One of four shapes: { duration_ms }, { until }, { event, deadline_ms } or { attention, form, options, labels }.

wait.trap: retry, output_format and always_run are errors on a wait node. Two pauses that can run at the same time are an error.

cancel.summary: Ends the run, with a reason.

fields.name: cancel
fields.help: The reason shown on the cancelled run.

fields.name: include
fields.help: The name of the workflow to inline.

fields.name: with
fields.help: Values for that workflow's inputs.

fields.name: fan_out
fields.help: { items, as, max_parallel, join } runs the block once per item.

include.trap: mutates_checkout is an error on an include node.

workflow.summary: Launches a child run of another workflow.

fields.name: workflow
fields.help: The name of the workflow to run.

fields.name: input
fields.help: The child's $ARGUMENTS.

fields.name: with
fields.help: The child's named inputs. input and with cannot both be set.

fields.name: isolation
fields.help: Whether the child gets a worktree of its own.

fields.name: fan_out
fields.help: { items, as, max_parallel, join } runs one child per item.

workflow.trap: Not allowed inside a loop body. retry is an error.

waitShapes.name: duration
waitShapes.help: Wait a fixed time in milliseconds.

waitShapes.name: until
waitShapes.help: Wait until an ISO-8601 time or a $node.output reference.

waitShapes.name: event
waitShapes.help: Wait for an event, up to a deadline in milliseconds.

waitShapes.name: attention
waitShapes.help: Ask a person. form is message, approval, select or multi_select; select needs options: [{id, label}].

commonFields.name: id
commonFields.help: Unique in its scope. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores are conventional; INPUTS is reserved.

commonFields.name: description
commonFields.help: Free text for people.

commonFields.name: depends_on
commonFields.help: Ids of the nodes this one waits for.
commonFields.trap: A node referenced in text or in when but missing here passes validation and fails at run time.

commonFields.name: when
commonFields.help: A condition; the node is skipped when it is false.

commonFields.name: trigger_rule
commonFields.help: How the node reacts to its dependencies' outcomes.
commonFields.trap: none_failed_min_one_success skips the node when no dependency completed.

commonFields.name: model
commonFields.help: A tier (small, medium, large), an @alias, a model name, or a list of two or more.

commonFields.name: provider
commonFields.help: The AI provider.

commonFields.name: effort
commonFields.help: Reasoning effort.

commonFields.name: maxBudgetUsd
commonFields.help: A spend cap for the node in USD; must be positive.

commonFields.name: fallbackModel
commonFields.help: The model to use when the first is unavailable.

commonFields.name: settingSources
commonFields.help: Which Claude settings layers the agent loads.
commonFields.trap: Archon runs agents with [project], so user hooks and user docs do not reach them.

commonFields.name: systemPrompt
commonFields.help: A system prompt for the agent.

commonFields.name: betas
commonFields.help: Beta feature flags.

commonFields.name: allowed_tools
commonFields.help: Tools the agent may use.

commonFields.name: denied_tools
commonFields.help: Tools the agent may not use.

commonFields.name: agents
commonFields.help: Inline subagents, keyed by kebab-case id.
commonFields.trap: Not yet run on this machine.

commonFields.name: hooks
commonFields.help: Hooks for the agent.

commonFields.name: mcp
commonFields.help: An MCP server configuration.

commonFields.name: skills
commonFields.help: Skills the agent may use.

commonFields.name: plugins
commonFields.help: Plugins the agent loads.

commonFields.name: sandbox
commonFields.help: A sandbox configuration.

commonFields.name: pi
commonFields.help: Settings for the pi provider.

commonFields.name: context
commonFields.help: Whether the node starts a fresh session, shares one, or resumes a node's session.
commonFields.trap: resume works only on prompt and command nodes.

commonFields.name: output_format
commonFields.help: A JSON schema for the node's output.
commonFields.trap: Comparing the whole output of an AI node to a literal is an error: declare output_format and compare a field.

commonFields.name: output_type
commonFields.help: A named output type.

commonFields.name: persist_session
commonFields.help: Keep the agent session after the node.

commonFields.name: idle_timeout
commonFields.help: Milliseconds without agent activity before the node fails. AI nodes only.

commonFields.name: retry
commonFields.help: { max_attempts 1-5, delay_ms 1000-60000, on_error }. AI nodes retry twice on transient errors by default.
commonFields.trap: Error on a wait, loop_group or workflow node.

commonFields.name: always_run
commonFields.help: Run the node even when the run is failing.

commonFields.name: mutates_checkout
commonFields.help: Whether the node changes the checkout.

triggerRules.name: all_success
triggerRules.help: Run only if every dependency completed.

triggerRules.name: all_done
triggerRules.help: Run once no dependency is pending or running.

triggerRules.name: none_failed_min_one_success
triggerRules.help: Run only if no dependency failed and at least one completed. Skipped when no dependency completed.

whenGrammar.rhs: a single-quoted string, a number, true or false
notes: && binds tighter than ||; there are no parentheses.
== and != compare strings, so == true compares to "true".
The numeric operators need a numeric right-hand side.
$LOOP_PREV is valid in loop bodies only.

workflowFields.name: returns
workflowFields.help: The node whose output the run returns.

workflowFields.name: outcome_field
workflowFields.help: The output field that decides the run outcome.

unknownKeyNote: The engine accepts unknown keys at node, nested-object and workflow level and only logs a warning, so a misspelled key name passes validation.
